Emscripten is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2014.

What it was for: [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [skull-emscripten](@/work/skull-emscripten.md): Emscripten Skull.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Emscripten: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Emscripten to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
